submission.justification: Provisional recommendation only. Selection-S1 at a 60% signal-efficiency working point gives the highest MC expected significance of the three strategies (4.116 sigma, versus 3.372 for S2 and 2.705 for S3, and the best S1 scan point, 4.116 at 60%). However, the hard constraint that data/MC disagreement in the signal-free validation region be at most 10% for the variables used has not been checked for any strategy: the recorded validation-region check count is 0 for all three, and validation_region_disagreement_verified = 0. So S1 cannot be cleared against that constraint yet. The 4.116 sigma figure also excludes systematic uncertainties (significance_includes_systematics = 0), so it is an optimistic upper bound. Before adoption, run the validation-region data/MC comparison for S1 at the 60% working point. If S1 fails the 10% limit, check S2 (best 3.372 at 40%) and then S3 (best 2.705 at 60%) in the same way, and re-evaluate the working point. Adopt only the first strategy that passes, and recompute significance with systematics included.

Recommended working point is 60% signal efficiency (wp_signal_efficiency_min_pct = 20, max = 80).
